posts.author: SergioV7
posts.body:
Hello!
I'm looking to comission someone that could help me create a character creation and customization system, if you have seen SummRndmDude's character creation plugin is pretty much looking for, the reason i'm not using it is because of the lack of mobile support.
The way i would like it to work is something like terraria, stardew valley.
Where you could choose hair/head piece, eyes, mouth, cheeks, ears, color, maybe clothing, we can talk about it more in depth if you are interested, i only really need it for the overworld sprites, i'm not interested in having that same customization for the battler sprites.
This is an  extra but i would like it for the equipment to change in someway the charcter, i mean visible equipment
what i do need is this system being in someway compatible with galv's extra frames and character animations.
If you are interested please comment or direct message me, i'm willing to hear pricing, do's and dont's and time

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
I built up a folder of bookmarks of different plugin authors from Itch, FunGameMake, this forum and the Japanese forum.
Tower Defense is just an ABS where the units are stationary. You can do it with any ABS plugin or ancillary ABS plugins like Galv Map Projectiles or QJ Bullet.
